label: Shobal

text.BHSA 1CH 4:1: בְּנֵ֖י יְהוּדָ֑ה פֶּ֧רֶץ חֶצְרֹ֛ון וְכַרְמִ֖י וְח֥וּר וְשֹׁובָֽל׃
text.KJV 1CH 4:1: The sons of Judah; Pharez, Hezron, and Carmi, and Hur, and Shobal.
text.BHSA 1CH 4:2: וּרְאָיָ֤ה בֶן־שֹׁובָל֙ הֹולִ֣יד אֶת־יַ֔חַת וְיַ֣חַת הֹלִ֔יד אֶת־אֲחוּמַ֖י וְאֶת־לָ֑הַד אֵ֖לֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹ֥ות הַצָּֽרְעָתִֽי׃ ס
text.KJV 1CH 4:2: And Reaiah the son of Shobal begat Jahath; and Jahath begat Ahumai, and Lahad. These are the families of the Zorathites.
text.BHSA 1CH 4:3: וְאֵ֨לֶּה֙ אֲבִ֣י עֵיטָ֔ם יִזְרְעֶ֥אל וְיִשְׁמָ֖א וְיִדְבָּ֑שׁ וְשֵׁ֥ם אֲחֹותָ֖ם הַצְלֶלְפֹּֽונִי׃
text.KJV 1CH 4:3: And these were of the father of Etam; Jezreel, and Ishma, and Idbash: and the name of their sister was Hazelelponi:

A.name: Shobal
A.line: son of Hur who founded Kiriath-jearim (1CH 2:50)
family: descendant-of judah (Judah, fourth-born son of Jacob (GEN 29:35), son of Leah)

B.name: Shobal
B.line: Listed among sons of Judah, father of Reaiah, ancestor of Zorathites; may duplicate bearer 2
family: son-of judah (Judah, fourth-born son of Jacob (GEN 29:35), son of Leah)

why: Reaiah is called בֶן־שׁוֹבָל, “son of Shobal,” and his descendants are Zorathite families, matching B’s stated identity in Judah’s list. However, A also names Reaiah as his son, and this passage does not explicitly identify Shobal’s father, so the distinction remains uncertain.
